Build is green now. Summary of what was going on and what I fixed:

**The screen of warnings** was mostly harmless noise from the bundler bump itself (Node deprecation notices like `fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc., plus tree-shaking/dedupe chatter) — those aren't errors and don't need code changes.

**The real breakage** was two spots the bumped bundler's shape changes exposed, both at the link stage:

1. `src/core/options.js` — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries` (undefined), so calling `.toFixed(0)` on it threw. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Fixed it to treat `undefined` as disabled.

Build now finishes with 0 errors (8 warnings remain, all deprecation noise, not build-breaking).
